name: block-toolbar
title: Block Toolbar
description: The one place a block's own controls sit: its top-right corner, 28px icon buttons named and tipped by their labels, at most four and a ⋯ menu for the rest, always shown or revealed on the block's hover and focus.

meta.whenToUse: A block in a document with controls of its own — a code block's copy, an image's caption and alt text, a diagram's expand — so every block's chrome sits in the same corner at the same size.
meta.whenNotToUse: A page's or a panel's toolbar (a header row of actions), or a selection's formatting (TextEdit's bubble).
